transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Ever since I started getting foreclosure notices, I feel like I’m just coming apart. I’ve been crying in my truck before work, and every time the phone rings I jump. I’m snapping at the apprentices, and I’ve been making stupid mistakes in the repair bay—things I normally wouldn’t mess up.
Do you feel this started because of the foreclosure notices?

Yes. It really started when those notices began showing up. Since then I’ve felt like I’m falling apart—crying before work, on edge whenever the phone rings, and I’m not acting like myself at the shop.
How long have you been feeling this way since the foreclosure notices started?
About four months now—ever since those foreclosure notices started coming in.
Aside from feeling on edge, have you been feeling depressed?
I’m not sure what you mean by depressed. I know I’ve been really overwhelmed and on edge, but I haven’t really thought of it that way.
Lately, have you been feeling down or sad much of the time?
I don’t know. I’ve been overwhelmed more than anything, but I haven’t really noticed whether I’m sad most of the time.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
Yeah, I guess so. I’ve stopped going to the fitness classes and the truck-club outings, and I haven’t been doing my church volunteering either. I used to keep up with all that.
Have you been feeling sad or down most days?
I honestly haven’t paid close attention to that. I just know I’ve been feeling really overwhelmed.
Nearly every day lately, have you been feeling sad or down?
I’m not sure I could say nearly every day. I’ve been so caught up in feeling overwhelmed that I haven’t really separated out whether I’m sad or down.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about lots of different things, not just the foreclosure?
I’m not really sure. I know the foreclosure has been taking up most of my thoughts.
Since this started, have you been feeling sad or down most of the day on more days than not?
I can’t really say it’s been most of the day more days than not. I’ve mostly just been focused on how overwhelmed I feel.
When you’re not dealing with the foreclosure, do you still find yourself worrying a lot about other parts of your life?
I’m not sure. It feels like the foreclosure is the main thing on my mind, but I haven’t really paid attention to whether I’m worrying a lot about other things too.
Aside from the foreclosure, have you been worrying a lot about other things?
I honestly haven’t noticed that. The foreclosure is what keeps coming back into my mind.
Since this started, have you been feeling anxious or nervous most days?
Yeah, most days. Ever since the foreclosure notices started, I’m on edge all the time—jumping whenever the phone rings.
In the past six months, have you been worrying a lot about several different parts of your life, not just the foreclosure?
I don’t think so, at least not that I’ve noticed. It’s mostly the foreclosure that I keep worrying about.
Since this started, have you been feeling down or sad most days?
Yeah. I’ve been feeling pretty down most days. I mean, I’ve been crying in my truck before work—I just feel like I’m coming apart at the seams.
Since the foreclosure notices started, have you been feeling down most days?
Yeah, I have. Most days I just feel overwhelmed and like I’m coming apart at the seams. I’ve been crying in my truck before work.
Since the foreclosure notices started, have you been crying a lot?
Yeah. I’ve been crying a lot more than usual—sometimes in my truck before work. It feels like I’m just coming apart at the seams.
Since the foreclosure notices started, have you felt down or sad on most days?
Yeah... most days I do. Ever since those notices started coming, I just feel like I’m coming apart at the seams.
Have these feelings been interfering with how well you function at work?
Yeah. They’ve taken me out of the high-risk repair bay at work. And outside of work, I’ve stopped going to church volunteering, my fitness classes, and the truck-club outings I used to keep up with.
Since the foreclosure notices started, have you been getting into fights or breaking rules more than usual?
I haven’t gotten into fights, but I have been snapping at the apprentices more than usual. Little things set me off lately, and I hate that.
